description: Sample dominant colors from a TOP by capturing its preview PNG and running deterministic k-means on the decoded RGB pixels. Returns `{source_top, k, width, height, pixels_sampled, hex_colors[], swatches[{hex,rgb,weight}], warnings[]}` sorted by dominance (most-frequent cluster first). Feeds AI grading prompts, `create_palette`, and design hand-offs. Read-only; no nodes are created or modified.

height.description: Height to render the preview at before sampling.

k.description: Number of palette colors to extract (2..16).

source_top.description: Path of the TOP to sample colors from.

width.description: Width to render the preview at before sampling (smaller is faster).

name: extract_palette
title: Extract a K-color palette from a TOP
